Accepted + planned orders grouped by delivery_date and zone.

Unplanned orders are grouped by their delivery address's zone; orders
reserved by a plan are counted in that plan's date + zone (so re-zoning an
address later doesn't move them).

schema.title: Response List Drivers Api Ops Drivers Get

post.description: Creates the login (role=driver) too. 409 if the e-mail is taken.

patch.description: active=false also deactivates the driver's login.

post.description:
Reserve all accepted, unreserved orders for this date + zone, create the
Plan and a queued solve Job, enqueue it, and return the plan (with job_id;
poll GET /api/jobs/{job_id}). 422 if there are none, or if some unit is
bigger than the vehicle (detail = InfeasibleDetail).

422.description: No orders to plan (detail is a string), or units that can't fit (detail is an InfeasibleDetail object).

schema.title: Response List Plans Api Ops Plans Get

delete.description:
Draft plans only: deletes its loads and releases its orders. The solve Job
is kept (a worker may still be running it); its payload's plan_id then
points at nothing.

post.description:
Write the loads of the job's `method` solution (409 if the job hasn't succeeded
or the plan is locked). Replaces any existing loads of this draft.

422 if the target load would exceed its capacity; 409 if the plan is locked.
Loads left empty are deleted and the remaining loads renumbered.

Draft with loads → locked; every order in it: accepted → planned.
409 if a load is over capacity or the plan has no loads.

patch.description:
Assign/clear the vehicle and driver (allowed on draft and locked plans).
422 if the load doesn't fit the new vehicle or the vehicle/driver is inactive.
Clearing the vehicle re-checks the load against the plan's capacity profile.

get.description: One row per company with delivered orders in `month` (business timezone).

schema.title: Response List Invoices Api Ops Invoices Get

get.description:
404 unless the order is on one of this driver's loads in a locked plan.
If several of the driver's loads carry it, the first one is shown.

post.description:
planned → picked_up → in_transit, or → exception (note required).
If an order is split over several loads and another driver already made
this change, returns 200 without writing a second event.

Record proof of delivery and move in_transit → delivered. The photo is
checked by content (magic bytes), not by its name or declared type, and
stored under UPLOAD_DIR with a server-generated name. 413 if too large,
415 if not an allowed image.

If the order is split over several loads and another driver already
delivered it, this driver's POD is stored without a second status change.

get.description:
Customers of the order's company, dispatchers, and the driver who recorded it
(or who carries the order). 404 for anyone else.
409 while queued/running, 409 with the error if failed.

AddressZoneUpdate.title: AddressZoneUpdate
AddressZoneUpdate.description: PATCH /api/ops/addresses/{id}: set or clear (null) the zone.

BatchSummary.title: BatchSummary
BatchSummary.description: Accepted orders grouped by delivery date + zone (zone null = address not zoned yet).

photo.title: Photo
photo.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

Capacity.title: Capacity
Capacity.description: Per-load limits. None = not limited. At least one is set.

DriverCreate.title: DriverCreate
DriverCreate.description: Creates a driver login (role=driver) and its driver profile.

DriverOrder.title: DriverOrder
DriverOrder.description: One order on a driver's load: pickup at pickup_address, drop at delivery_address.

DriverRun.title: DriverRun
DriverRun.description: GET /api/driver/run: the driver's loads in LOCKED plans for one date.

DriverStatusUpdate.title: DriverStatusUpdate
DriverStatusUpdate.description: `delivered` is not allowed here: use the POD upload. `exception` needs a note.

FillPercent.title: FillPercent
FillPercent.description: Usage as % of capacity, per limited dimension (None where not limited).

LineMove.title: LineMove
LineMove.description:
Move `quantity` units of an order line from one load to another load of
the same plan (to_load_id null = into a new load). quantity null = all
units of that line on from_load. 422 if the target would exceed capacity.

LoadUpdate.title: LoadUpdate
LoadUpdate.description:
Assign (or clear with null) a vehicle and/or driver. Only sent fields change.
Changing the vehicle re-validates the load against its capacity (422).

OrderCreate.title: OrderCreate
OrderCreate.description: Creates a DRAFT order. Items and addresses must belong to the caller's company.

OrderRead.title: OrderRead
OrderRead.description: Order detail with lines, timeline, quote and proof of delivery.

OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus
OrderStatus.description:
draft → submitted → accepted | rejected → planned → picked_up → in_transit
→ delivered | exception. Also `cancelled` (customer, from draft or
submitted). The allowed transitions live in app/lifecycle.py only.

OrderSummary.title: OrderSummary
OrderSummary.description: One row of an order list (portal and ops).

OrderUpdate.title: OrderUpdate
OrderUpdate.description: Draft orders only. When `lines` is sent it REPLACES all lines.

PackUnit.title: PackUnit
PackUnit.description: One unit (1 of an order line's quantity). `id` = index in SolveResult.units.

PlanSaveDraft.title: PlanSaveDraft
PlanSaveDraft.description: Write the loads of one method's solution. Replaces existing loads of a draft plan.

QuoteRead.title: QuoteRead
QuoteRead.description: `id` and `created_at` are null for a preview that was not stored.

StatusNote.title: StatusNote
StatusNote.description: Body of submit / cancel / accept: an optional note for the event log.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Public sign-up. Always creates a NEW customer company with this user as
its first customer user. `role`, `is_superuser` etc. cannot be chosen.

VehicleUpdate.title: VehicleUpdate
VehicleUpdate.description: The server re-checks that at least one capacity remains set.

code.title: Code
code.description: Uppercase letters, digits, '_' or '-', up to 32 chars.
